title: afm config
description: Schema for an afm config.yaml (.afm/config.yaml or ~/.afm/config.yaml). See https://akopichin.github.io/afm/config-reference/

prompts_dir.description: Directory with custom prompt templates; missing files fall back to the embedded defaults.

theme.description: Dashboard theme. Default graphite. "coffee" is a legacy alias for graphite.

skin_dir.description: A fully custom dashboard skin directory (containing index.css). Overrides `theme`.

auto_recover.description: Auto-reset failed stages to pending on run start/resume. Default true.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks: observer commands receiving event JSON on stdin (global/project layers).

accounting.description: Cost/usage accounting DISPLAY switch (dashboard cost UI, `afm check` cost columns, `afm report`). Collection into usage.jsonl is unaffected.

enabled.description: Show accounting. ON by default; explicit false / env AFM_ACCOUNTING=0 hides the display (data is still collected).

command.description: The AI command to run as the agent. Default "claude".

extra_args.description: Extra arguments appended to the command.

claude_bare.description: Add --bare to generated claude wrappers (lighter, but disables skill auto-discovery). Default false.

idle_timeout.description: Max idle time with no agent output before the process is killed. Default 30m.

max_parallel.description: Max stages running in parallel (0 = unlimited).

truncate_output.description: Max chars of agent text/Bash detail logged (0 = no limit).

open_browser.description: Open the dashboard in a browser on startup. Default false.

enabled.description: Enable Docker mode. Unset falls back to $AFM_USE_DOCKER.

image.description: Docker image to run. Default akopichin/afm:latest.

autoShim.description: Generate claude-compatible wrappers for docker.agents inside the container.

secrets_file.description: Optional path to a file with secrets for autoShim auth.from lookups.

extra_mounts.description: Extra host paths mounted into the container (:ro). Each item is a string or an object.

file_browser.description: The dashboard project file browser (Docker mode only).

enabled.description: Enable the file browser. ON by default; env AFM_FILE_BROWSER overrides.

agentRecipe.description: An autoShim wrapper recipe for a custom agent command.

system_prompt.description: Optional "file:<path>" whose content is appended as the system prompt.

max_turns.description: openai-agent only: max tool-call iterations per invocation (0 = default 40).

recipeAuth.description: Where afm reads the secret on the host (from) and which env var the wrapper exports (to).

from.description: "env:VAR" or "file:<path>" — the secret source on the host.

to.description: "env:<VAR>" — the env var the generated wrapper exports.

pricing.description: Overrides/extends the built-in accounting rate table (list-price USD per 1M tokens — an estimate, not a bank charge).

rateCard.description: A (possibly partial) set of category rates, decimal USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Omitted = fall back to the built-in default; explicit 0 disables that category's cost.

cache_write.description: Cache-write fallback for a TTL with no specific rate.

extraMount.description: Either a bare host path string (browse:false), or an object.

anyOf.description: Legacy scalar form: a host path (browse:false).

name.description: Optional UI label for the file browser.

browse.description: Expose this mount in the file browser. Default false.

lifecycleHook.description: A lifecycle hook: an observer command that receives the event JSON payload on stdin. Its exit status never affects the flow.

id.description: Unique hook id within its layer; also the hook log file name (must be a safe path component).

command.description: The command line, run via `sh -c` with the event JSON payload on stdin.

retries.description: Extra retry attempts after a non-zero exit. Default 0 (single attempt).

env.description: Hook process env: target var -> env:NAME | file:PATH source reference

inherit_env.description: Inherit the whole afm process environment. Default false (minimal env).

lifecycleEventSelector.description: Either the scalar "all", or a non-empty list of event names (validated by afm at load time).
